externals.notes: Free-tier route for ALL operations of this model. training: T4 kernels (index + smoketest) train from the staged train tar and push the model to the Hub. evaluation: T4 kernels benchmark the Hub model on the staged, unseen val split and publish the results to the model card. testing: T4 kernels measure runtime performance on a staged half of the test split (no public ground truth, so no accuracy metrics) and publish those to the model card too. Each stage stages its own data via a CPU prepare-data kernel — the dataset itself is already prepared on the Hub (Lekim89/sportsmot), so no data-preparation stage is delegated. Launched via the workspace run.sh / run.ps1 launcher, which resolves this reference.
